arabic text: Lori armaano se bharpur sunalu mere asghar aaja
english translation text: Come, my Asghar; tonight let me put you to sleep in my lap and sing you a lullaby filled with all my longings.

arabic text: Teer ke aage mere, laal tujhe hona hai\nDekh kar teri haseen zulm ne bhi rona hai Jo tareeke hai\nlaraeen ke sikhalun Mere Asghar aaja
english translation text: My child, you must soon face the arrow.\nEven cruelty itself will weep upon seeing your beauty.\nCome, my Asghar, so I may teach you the ways of the accursed ones.

arabic text: Tujhko ik baar dafan, baba tere kardenge Phir tujhe neze\nsakifa ke wahan dhoondenge Dasht ki gharm hawaoon se\nchupalun Mere Asghar aaja
english translation text: Your father will bury you once;\nthen the people of Saqifa will search for you with spears.\nCome, my Asghar, so I may hide you from the desert's scorching winds.

arabic text:
Teri masoom sakina ko pilaake paani
Kal teri pyaas bujhaega Ali ka saani
Mein tujhe dekh ke pyaas apni bujhaloon Mere asghar
aaja
english translation text:
After giving water to innocent Sakina, tomorrow
the second Ali will quench your thirst.
Come, my Asghar, so I may quench
my own thirst by looking at you.

arabic text: Pyaas asghar ki jo dekhi to, uthi ek buka Haye ye shaame\nghaariban ko sakina ne kaha Hoke paband tujhe paani\npilaloon Mere asghar aaja
english translation text: When Sakina saw Asghar's thirst, a cry arose.\nOn the night of loneliness she said:\ncome, my Asghar, so I may give you water while bound in ropes.

arabic text: Hai to aakhir ko woh maa kehta hai zair ka yaqeen\nDhoond thi hogi usse ro ro ke raahon mein kahin Kehti\nhogi ke tere naaz uthaloon Mere asghar aaja
english translation text: After all, she is a mother, says the visitor with certainty.\nShe must have searched for him, weeping along every road,\nsaying: come, my Asghar, so I may cherish you.
